name: Bind Spectre
sub: → Zealous Excavator · Act 4 · minion skill 1 (Orb Explosion)
note: 2.6× the Vaal Guard on the same setup. For mapping: Nymph Wasp (Ashen Forest, Interlude · skill 3) does 65% of the damage at 2.3× the speed, 48 Spirit. ⚠ Not Bleed IV here: it can't cause bleeding and only boosts melee hits — 11% less on this spectre, and your melee minions rely on this Bleed to keep enemies bleeding.

name: Skeletal Brute
note: 1.12× Brute damage from Bleed IV + Bloodlust (they replace Bleed III and Heavy Swing). Both need enemies already bleeding — the Spectre, Sniper and Detonate Dead keep Bleed III for that.

name: Skeletal Frost Mage
note: Rakiata's Flow is worth about 2.5× Frost Mage damage; nothing replaces it. Muster replaces Rapid Casting II (1.27×).

alt.name: Skeletal Reaver
alt.text: use instead until you have Rakiata's Flow — 3,642 DPS for 25 Spirit (Frost Mage without it: 1,976 for 32). Supports: Feeding Frenzy, Muster, Brutality III, Heavy Swing, Bloodlust.

name: Skeletal Sniper
note: ⚠ Not Bleed IV here: it can't cause bleeding and only boosts melee hits — 18% less on this ranged minion, and your melee minions rely on this Bleed to keep enemies bleeding.

name: Skeletal Warrior
note: 1.42× Warrior damage over the old set: Muster replaces Hulking Minions; Bleed IV + Bloodlust replace Heavy Swing + Bleed III.

name: Summon Infernal Hound
note: 1.24× Hound damage (Bleed IV + Bloodlust replace Heft + Bleed III). Keep Loyalty — it takes 10% of the hits aimed at you. PoB can't store supports on the Hound — socket them in game.

name: Detonate Dead
note: +37% on top of the army. First three: 1.80×. Slots 4–5 are Int (no Str support helps): Concentrated Area 1.30×, then Rapid Casting III — it speeds up per different spell you've cast recently: 1.27× with 3, 1.36× with 4 (Unearth, Pain Offering, Detonate Dead, Vulnerability). If you rarely cast 3+ different spells, use Unleash (1.20×). Rapid Casting II is weaker than both (1.18×). ⚠ Not Bleed IV here: Detonate Dead isn't melee, so Bleed IV loses 15% and stops it causing bleeding.

name: Pain Offering
note: Use both Offering supports — they stack: 1.13× army damage together, 1.14× with Minion Mastery. Sacrificial Offering costs some of your Life per cast; Danse Macabre also targets one extra skeleton. Nothing else measurably helps, so slots 4–5 are free.

name: Vulnerability

alt.name: Despair
alt.text: use instead if enemies resist physical damage

note: +7% army damage. Curse supports change strength, area or duration — PoB can't score them.

name: Unearth
note: Consumes corpses → Bone Constructs. Bleed IV and Bloodlust stack here too. Its damage is small next to the army, so these are low priority.

name: Skeletal Cleric

alt.name: Discipline
alt.text: +328 ES, +18% EHP — if its Spirit cost fits (unknown)

note: Meat Shield is right here: it cuts the Cleric's damage (which it doesn't need) and the damage it takes. Infernal Legion is out — it sets the Cleric itself on fire. Prolonged Duration II lengthens its Heal buff (PoB can't score it). Hulking Minions doesn't raise its Spirit cost. Multipliers = Cleric survival.
